# The Globe and Mail

> Canadian national news publication covering politics, business, investing, world affairs, culture, sports, and analysis.

The Globe and Mail is a major Canadian newspaper and digital news site with broad coverage of national and international news, deep business and market reporting, opinion, personal finance, and lifestyle journalism. Its site is organized into major editorial sections and specialized verticals including Report on Business, Globe Investor, Globe Advisor, and Globe Drive.

## Top News Sections
- [Canada](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/canada/): Canadian news coverage including national affairs, regional developments, and breaking stories.
- [World](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/world/): International news and analysis on global events, conflicts, and diplomacy.
- [Politics](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/politics/): Federal and provincial politics, policy reporting, elections, and government accountability coverage.
- [Opinion](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/opinion/): Editorials, columns, analysis, and commentary from Globe writers and contributors.
- [Newsletters](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/newsletters/): Editorial newsletters covering major news, business, and specialized topics.
- [Video](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/video/): News videos, interviews, explainers, and feature reporting.

## Business & Economy
- [Business](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/): Report on Business coverage of companies, economy, technology, and leadership.
- [Economy](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/economy/): Canadian and global economic news, inflation, rates, jobs, and policy.
- [Small Business](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/small-business/): Reporting and advice for entrepreneurs, owners, and Canadian small businesses.
- [Careers](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/careers/): Workplace trends, executive moves, management, and career development coverage.
- [Technology](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/technology/): Technology industry news, digital policy, platforms, and innovation reporting.
- [International Business](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/international-business/): Global business developments, trade, and multinational company coverage.

## Investing & Personal Finance
- [Investing](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/): Market news, investing analysis, portfolios, and wealth coverage.
- [Personal Finance](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/personal-finance/): Consumer finance guidance on saving, taxes, debt, and retirement planning.
- [Markets](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/): Stock market coverage, trading news, and market-moving developments.
- [Retirement](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/personal-finance/retirement/): Retirement income, pensions, savings strategies, and later-life financial planning.
- [Carrick on Money](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/personal-finance/household-finances/): Personal finance reporting and practical money advice for households.
- [Globe Investor](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/globe-investor/): Investing tools, market data, and analysis for Canadian investors.

## Wealth & Professional Advice
- [Globe Advisor](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/globe-advisor/): Wealth management news and practice insights for financial professionals.
- [Advisor News](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/globe-advisor/news/): Reporting on regulation, firms, products, and advisor industry developments.
- [Portfolio Strategy](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/globe-advisor/portfolio-strategy/): Investment strategy ideas and portfolio construction perspectives for advisors.
- [Practice Management](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/globe-advisor/practice-management/): Guidance on running advisory practices, client service, and business growth.
- [Insurance](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/globe-advisor/insurance/): Insurance industry coverage, products, regulation, and planning considerations.
- [Tax](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/globe-advisor/tax/): Tax planning developments and analysis relevant to advisors and investors.

## Life, Health & Real Estate
- [Life](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/life/): Lifestyle journalism covering health, relationships, food, travel, and living.
- [Health](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/life/health-and-fitness/): Health reporting, wellness features, medical news, and fitness coverage.
- [Food and Drink](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/life/food-and-wine/): Recipes, restaurant coverage, drinks writing, and food culture features.
- [Style](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/life/style/): Fashion, design, beauty, and consumer lifestyle trends.
- [Travel](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/life/travel/): Travel features, destination reporting, and practical trip advice.
- [Real Estate](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/real-estate/): Housing market news, homeownership trends, and Canadian real estate analysis.

## Arts, Books & Entertainment
- [Arts](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/arts/): Coverage of visual arts, performance, film, television, and cultural issues.
- [Books](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/arts/books-and-media/): Book reviews, author interviews, publishing news, and literary commentary.
- [Film](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/arts/film/): Movie reviews, festival coverage, and film industry reporting.
- [Television](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/arts/television/): TV reviews, streaming coverage, and television industry analysis.
- [Music](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/arts/music/): Music reviews, artist features, and industry news.
- [Awards and Festivals](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/arts/awards-and-festivals/): Coverage of major cultural awards, festivals, and event highlights.

## Sports & Autos
- [Sports](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/sports/): Canadian and international sports news, analysis, and commentary.
- [NHL](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/sports/hockey/): Hockey reporting with emphasis on NHL news and Canadian teams.
- [NBA](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/sports/basketball/): Basketball news, analysis, and major league coverage.
- [Soccer](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/sports/soccer/): Soccer reporting on international competitions and club developments.
- [Globe Drive](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/drive/): Automotive reviews, industry news, and driving-related features.
- [New Cars](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/drive/reviews/new-cars/): Reviews and first drives of new vehicle models.
- [Used Cars](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/drive/reviews/used-cars/): Used vehicle reviews and buying guidance for consumers.

## Special Coverage & Features
- [Climate](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/topics/climate-change/): Reporting and analysis on climate change, policy, and environmental impacts.
- [Coronavirus](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/topics/coronavirus/): Archived and ongoing pandemic coverage, data, and public health reporting.
- [Investigations](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/topics/investigations/): In-depth investigative journalism and accountability reporting.
- [Editorial Board](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/opinion/editorials/): Official editorial positions and unsigned opinion pieces from the board.
- [Columnists](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/opinion/): Commentary from regular opinion writers and guest contributors.
- [Podcasts](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/podcasts/): Audio journalism, interviews, and serialized news discussions.

## Subscriber & Reader Services
- [Today's Paper](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/todays-newspaper/): Digital access to the day’s newspaper edition and curated print content.
- [Crossword](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/puzzles-and-crosswords/cryptic-crossword/): Crossword and puzzle content for readers and subscribers.
- [Puzzles and Crosswords](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/puzzles-and-crosswords/): Interactive puzzles, games, and crossword archives.
- [Gift Subscriptions](https://subscribe.theglobeandmail.com/): Subscription offers and gifting options for Globe access.
- [Customer Care](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/self-service/): Account help, subscription management, and reader support resources.
- [ePaper](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/todays-newspaper/): Replica newspaper reading experience for digital subscribers.
